meta.title: Aikido for children
meta.description: Aikido for children in Mariánské Lázně. Development of coordination, confidence, and discipline. Information for parents about children's training sessions at BUDO CLUB.

intro: Aikido is an ideal martial art for children. It develops coordination, balance, discipline, and respect for others. Unlike other martial arts, there is no competition in aikido – children learn to cooperate and help each other.
benefits: Development of motor skills and coordination
Ability to resolve conflicts without violence
practicalText: Children train in comfortable clothing – sweatpants and a long-sleeve shirt. Training is done barefoot. A kimono is not required right away. Don't forget a bottle of water.
parentsText: Parents are welcome to observe the training sessions. If you have any questions about your child's health in relation to training, please do not hesitate to contact us.
